title: Points Accrual and Corporate Eligibility by Hotel Rate Plan
content:
What a stay earns in the Wanderlane Traveller Club, and whether a Hotel Rate Plans reservation may be taken under a corporate travel programme rate at all, is recorded against the plan booked.

| Rate plan | Points earned on the room total, percent | Tier-qualifying points multiplier | Corporate programme rate may be applied |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 0 | 0.0 | no |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 50 | 0.5 | no |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 75 | 1.0 | yes |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 100 | 1.0 | yes |
| Member Flex Rate | 150 | 1.5 | no |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 125 | 1.25 | yes |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 150 | 1.5 | no |

The **earn rate** is the percentage of the room total that accrues as traveller club points. The **tier-qualifying multiplier** is the multiplier applied to room spend when counting tier-qualifying points. **Corporate eligibility** records whether a corporate travel programme rate may be applied to the plan.

## Points of judgement

*The plan that earns nothing.* The Non-Refundable Saver Rate records an earn rate of 0 percent and a multiplier of 0.0, so a stay on it accrues neither points nor tier-qualifying credit.

*The richest plans.* The Member Flex Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate both record 150 percent and a multiplier of 1.5, the Suite Flexible Rate 125 percent and 1.25.

*Where the two columns diverge.* The three plans eligible for a corporate rate — the Semi-Flexible Rate, the Standard Flexible Rate and the Suite Flexible Rate — are not the plans with the highest earn rates, and the two richest earning plans are both ineligible.

*A worked reading.* On a hypothetical room total of 600.00 USD at the 75 percent this schedule records for the Semi-Flexible Rate, 450 points accrue.
